newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation Feb load declines.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation Feb load declines.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Monday its February passenger load factor fell 3.6 points to 40.6 percent from 44.2 percent in the same year-ago period.
It said revenue passenger miles fell 5.8 percent to 19.9 million from 21.2 million, and available seat miles were up 2.6 percent at 49.1 million from 47.9 million.
Year to date, the carrier said its load factor was down 1.9 points to 39.9 percent from 41.8 percent in 1996.
It said revenue passenger miles fell 2.5 percent to 39.6 million from 40.7 million, and available seat miles rose 2.1 percent to 99.2 million from 97.2 million.
Great Lakes Aviation said flight statistics for February 1997 are not directly comparable to February 1996 because 1996 was a leap year.
The carrier maintains three regional airline marketing identities, providing scheduled passenger and air freight service.
